member.description: a person’s seat on a space’s roster

role.description: owner runs the space and owns everything in it; member belongs, and reaches what they are granted

grant.description: what one person may do with one app

app.description: the app the grant is on

person.description: the person it is for — absent on a share link, which names a token instead

token.description: an unguessable secret standing in for a person: whoever opens it acts AS this grant

access.description: owner shares and deletes, editor writes, viewer reads
what an app says about everyone with no grant on it

mode.description: public: anyone reads. open: anyone reads and writes. private: only the granted see it.
